questions.question: What is Generative AI?
questions.ideal_answer: Generative AI creates text, images, audio or code from learned patterns.

questions.question: What is an LLM?
questions.ideal_answer: A Large Language Model is trained on massive text datasets to generate human-like text.

questions.question: What is Prompt Engineering?
questions.ideal_answer: Prompt engineering is designing effective prompts to guide AI outputs.

questions.question: What is Tokenization?
questions.ideal_answer: Breaking text into tokens processed by the model.

questions.question: What are Embeddings?
questions.ideal_answer: Numerical representations of text used for semantic understanding.

questions.question: What is Transformer Architecture?
questions.ideal_answer: A neural network using self-attention mechanisms.

questions.question: What is RAG?
questions.ideal_answer: Combines retrieval and generation for accurate responses.

questions.question: What is LangChain?
questions.ideal_answer: A framework for building LLM applications.

questions.question: What is Fine-Tuning?
questions.ideal_answer: Training an existing model on domain-specific data.

questions.question: Reduce Hallucinations?
questions.ideal_answer: Use RAG, validation layers and better prompts.

questions.question: Fine-Tuning vs Prompt Engineering?
questions.ideal_answer: Fine-tuning changes model weights, prompting changes instructions.

questions.question: Design Enterprise RAG.
questions.ideal_answer: Documents → embeddings → vector DB → retriever → LLM.

questions.question: Multi-Agent Architecture?
questions.ideal_answer: Multiple AI agents collaborate on specialized tasks.

questions.question: Evaluate LLM System?
questions.ideal_answer: Measure accuracy, relevance, latency and user satisfaction.
